inputs.text: Support-programme workers at the Ministry of Education, Sport and Youth are being asked to trust government assurances while their jobs remain without legally binding protection. Their protest outside the Presidential Palace and 24-hour strike make clear that workers should not have to risk their livelihoods just to get promises put into law. If the government says it has met their main demands, it should prove that by guaranteeing job security—not by expecting workers to accept uncertainty.
